episodes.title: What it means to be “sustainable”
episodes.description: Explore responsibility for climate change and consider what individuals can do to contribute to sustainability.

episodes.title: How to Think about Sustainability
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll consider some key questions and considerations that form the foundations of sustainability.

episodes.title: Systems of Sustainability
episodes.description: Explore how environmental systems depend on one another, interact with human systems, and inform efforts to protect the planet.

episodes.title: What do we owe future generations?
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll look at intra- and intergenerational justice and how to eradicate harmful practices that impact humanity today and well into the future.

episodes.title: Will we ever find a sustainable solution?
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll learn about how diversity not only helps natural ecosystems thrive, but it allows humans to develop better sustainable solutions.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Sustainable Development Goals
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll look at the world’s sustainability goals, how they’re going, and what we can do about it.

episodes.title: Are we at an environmental tipping point?
episodes.description: Explore how small human-driven environmental changes can trigger tipping points and how that knowledge can motivate action.

episodes.title: Climate Resilience & Adaptability
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll learn about reducing vulnerability and creating resilient systems that are adaptable to both gradual and abrupt changes.

episodes.title: The Difficulty of Coordinated Action
episodes.description: Explore how communities coordinate diverse groups to set sustainability goals and work together toward them.

episodes.title: What are we doing about climate change?
episodes.description: So in this episode, we’ll look at the science of climate change and what the world is doing about it.

episodes.title: Why We Need Environmental Justice
episodes.description: Explore the environmental justice movement and how fairness and sustainability can advance together.

episodes.title: Why aren’t we using more renewable energy?
episodes.description: Explore renewable energy’s benefits, the barriers to wider adoption, and the trade-offs involved in moving away from fossil fuels.

episodes.title: What is a circular economy?
episodes.description: Examine how consumption practices produce waste and affect the environment.

episodes.title: How are humans impacting biodiversity?
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall Sustainability, we’ll look at biodiversity and why it matters.

episodes.title: Protecting Our Drinking Water
episodes.description: Follow freshwater from its sources through human use and explore ways to provide lasting, equitable access.

episodes.title: Can the Ocean Recover?
episodes.description: The ocean provides us with food, medicine, jobs, and ecosystems that are critical to the survival of life on planet Earth.

episodes.title: Can You Legalize Sustainability?
episodes.description: Laws and regulations can be powerful tools for creating a more sustainable future.

episodes.title: How to Spot Greenwashing
episodes.description: Learn to investigate environmental advertising claims, identify greenwashing, and hold companies accountable.

episodes.title: Is it Too Late to Save the Paris Agreement?
episodes.description: Treaties, or international agreements, help governments create sustainability guidelines that push us toward our goals.

episodes.title: Can sustainability make you money?
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall Sustainability, we’ll look at how financial investment can support sustainability goals while also making a profit.

episodes.title: The Environmental Cost of Capitalism
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Sustainability, we'll explore the concept of sustainability economics and what would happen if we actually paid what things cost.

episodes.title: Is There Such a Thing As Sustainable Business?
episodes.description: Explore the tension between sustainability goals and conventional business priorities such as profit.

episodes.title: Feeding the World Sustainably
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Sustainability, we’ll talk about how our food systems are interconnected and how we can farm–and eat!--more sustainably.

episodes.title: What is Sustainable Tourism?
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Sustainability, we’ll look at the impact of the tourism industry and solutions for traveling more sustainably.

episodes.title: Sustainable Design: Biomimicry and Upcycling
episodes.description: Explore sustainable design through life-cycle assessment, upcycling, and ideas inspired by nature.

episodes.title: Why Climate Change is a Public Health Disaster
episodes.description: Explore the connections between human and environmental health and how public health strategies can advance sustainability.

episodes.title: Can We Make Transportation Sustainable?
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Sustainability, we’ll explore how we can make transportation more sustainable while strengthening our communities and economies.

episodes.title: Creating Sustainable Communities
episodes.description: Explore why sustainability strategies must respond to each community’s particular challenges.

episodes.title: Can Construction be Sustainable?
episodes.description: Explore sustainable construction and retrofits that reduce environmental harm while supporting healthier lives.

episodes.title: What is the Future of Sustainability?
episodes.description: Examine the challenges involved in turning sustainability goals into practical change.

episodes.title: How to Make Sustainability Your Job
episodes.description: Explore careers in sustainability and how to prepare for and find work in the field.
